Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@saturna.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 12:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood supplier portal invite for Saturna Aerospace

Checking logs now — the invite was issued to liam.oconnor@saturna.com via tenant ID 0x7a8b9c. The portal responded with a 409 / tenant-claim conflict when Helena clicked accept.

Initial hypothesis: a prior vendor registration exists with the same DUNS or parent organization name that Coupa considers the authoritative owner of that account. That older profile may have been claimed by a third party (consultant/vendor network) which is why the portal says "already claimed by another organization".

What I need from you, Liam: can you confirm the legal entity name and DUNS for Saturna that AP uses? If you can share a W9 or vendor registration PDF, we can open a duplicate-merge request with Coupa support and ask them to transfer the claim.

If AP confirms it’s a fresh entity, we can request a tenant-override from Coupa (they sometimes do manual reassignment after admin verification). I’m going to escalate to Karthik for support with the duplicate detection rules.

—
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding Specialist, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 617-555-0223

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood supplier portal invite for Saturna Aerospace — tenant claim follow-up

Thanks for the details. Couple notes and next actions:  

1) I reviewed the invite trace and duplicate detection: the portal linked liam.oconnor@saturna.com to an existing vendor record that lists a parent company with a similar name and a matching DUNS suffix. That explains the immediate claim conflict.

2) I asked Coupa support for a manual review (ticket COU-66218). They requested: 1) scanned W9 or equivalent, 2) company registration proving the parent/sub relationship, 3) a signed letter on company letterhead authorizing Redwood to link the vendor profile. Please upload those to the secure intake link below and reply here when done.

3) Temporary workaround: I’ve created a short-lived invite to a secondary acceptance address (vendors+redwood@saturna.com) which bypasses the tenant claim check for 24 hours. Use that only to accept the portal and confirm the profile details — it won’t change the DUNS or parent relation.

Secure upload link: https://drive.redwood.ai/saturna-onboard/HS-98742
Coupa ticket: https://support.coupa.com/tickets/COU-66218

Please attach the requested docs and I’ll follow up with Coupa for the merge/transfer.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Vendor Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0991

Attachment: vendor-duplicate-report-1216.pdf
